parameters.name: Order
parameters.description: The sort order. Valid values: `asc` for ascending and `desc` for descending. Default value: `desc`.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of results to return per page.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description: The field to sort the results by. Default value: `GmtCreateTime`.

parameters.name: TemplateId
parameters.description: The job template ID. Use this parameter to filter for an exact match.

parameters.name: TemplateName
parameters.description: The job template name. Use this parameter to filter for a partial match.

parameters.name: UserId
parameters.description: The ID of the creator. Use this parameter to filter results by a specific creator.
